summary.intent: Work through pending GSD todos: wire CTR encryption for media uploads in the SDK, debug BYO-IPFS 400 errors on staging, fix the release gate CI workflow incorrectly failing, and update GitHub Actions to Node.js 24-compatible versions.
summary.outcome: Four todos completed and merged to main: SDK now correctly selects CTR/GCM per MIME type, new PATCH /vault/byo-status endpoint unblocks BYO load testing, release gate rewritten to search standalone desktop-e2e.yml runs directly, and 11 GitHub Actions bumped to latest versions with Dependabot configured for future updates.

repo: STREAMING_MIME_TYPES was duplicated between packages/sdk/src/client.ts and apps/web/src/services/streaming-crypto.service.ts — now centralized in packages/sdk-core/src/encryption-mode.ts

VaultService.setByoStatus() was dead code — existed as a service method with no controller endpoint, meaning BYO mode could never be enabled via the API; the web settings UI had no way to toggle it server-side
The release gate (release-gate.yml) only searched ci-e2e.yml orchestrator runs, but successful desktop E2E tests ran as standalone desktop-e2e.yml workflows — the gate never found them

Jest test mocks using jest.Mocked<Partial<T>> lose mock method types after module.get() — the returned type is the full service type, not the partial mock; use the original mock variable directly instead
The pnpm api:generate lint step scanned target/ (Rust build artifacts and docs) producing 261 spurious ESLint errors — target/** was not in eslint.config.js ignores
FLAC audio (audio/flac) was missing from STREAMING_MIME_TYPES in both the SDK and web service, so FLAC files were incorrectly getting GCM instead of CTR encryption
The duplicate pending todo for SDK GCM fix was caused by the merge from fix/e2e-test-failures-v2 bringing both pending/ and done/ copies into main
ci-e2e.yml orchestrator skips desktop E2E jobs per-commit when no desktop changes are detected, so the release gate's job introspection approach was fundamentally broken for this pattern
Husky commit-msg hook is overwritten by Entire CLI locally — should be added to .git/info/exclude to prevent it showing in git diffs; commit-msg.pre-entire should also be excluded

code.finding: uploadFile() hardcoded encryptAesGcm regardless of file type; needed encryptionMode param to switch to encryptAesCtr + generateCtrIv for CTR mode
uploadFile() didn't call selectEncryptionMode before delegating to sdkCore — mode selection was never triggered for new uploads
New centralized module: selectEncryptionMode(mimeType, size) returns CTR for video/mp4, audio/*, video/webm >256KB; normalizeEncryptionMode() coerces invalid values to GCM
Added PATCH /vault/byo-status endpoint with SetByoStatusDto and SetByoStatusResponseDto; setByoStatus was previously unreachable
ipns-publish call sent { ipnsName, cid } but PublishIpnsEntryDto requires { ipnsName, record, metadataCid } — replaced with createAndPublishIpnsRecord from sdk-core
createByoClientPool never enabled BYO mode on test accounts — added PATCH /vault/byo-status call after account creation; filters out failed enables and throws if zero succeed
Old logic broke on first failed ci-e2e run without checking if desktop tests actually ran; rewritten to walk commits newest-first and search desktop-e2e.yml runs directly by SHA
Systemic pattern: spec files used jest.Mocked<Partial<T>> then re-fetched via module.get() losing mock types; fix is to use the original mock variable directly without re-fetching

workflow: When SDK mock tests use vi.mock('@cipherbox/sdk-core', () => ({...})) with a bare factory, new exports from sdk-core break the mock — use importOriginal + spread to survive future export additions
pnpm api:generate requires the API server to be running for OpenAPI spec generation; the generate script writes to packages/api-client/openapi.json not cwd
GitHub Actions settings with github_owned_allowed: true and verified_allowed: true cover all first-party and verified publisher action updates — no allowlist changes needed for version bumps

Major version action tags (@v4, @v5) are maintained by authors to point to latest secure release; SHA pinning is appropriate for public repos but adds maintenance burden — Dependabot manages this automatically

friction: GraphQL API for fetching review threads timed out multiple times, requiring REST API fallback for PR comment operations
Accidentally committed openapi.json to apps/api/openapi.json (cwd) instead of packages/api-client/openapi.json — had to rm and push a fix commit
Nine pre-existing API test files with jest.Mocked<Partial<T>> type errors had to be fixed before CI could pass — unrelated to the feature work
Entire CLI rewrote .husky/commit-msg locally, causing it to appear as a dirty file in git status; required .git/info/exclude entries for both commit-msg and commit-msg.pre-entire
sdk-core build output was stale causing sdk typecheck to fail — had to rebuild sdk-core before typechecking sdk
The merge of fix/e2e-test-failures-v2 brought both pending/ and done/ copies of the SDK todo into main, requiring manual cleanup
Background task notifications frequently arrived for operations already resolved in the main conversation thread, creating noise
Release gate fix required three iterations: first fixing stop-at-first-failure, then discovering the wrong workflow was being searched entirely, then simplifying to direct desktop-e2e.yml search

Research CRDT-based IPNS inbox for serverless share discovery (architecture, 36d pending)
Make search index build async/incremental for large vaults (ui, 34d pending)
Add alternative MFA factor types (auth, 32d pending)
Investigate removal of mock-ipns-routing layer (api, 7d pending)
MigrationStatusDto.completedAt typed as object instead of Date — pre-existing issue from Phase 35 TEE migration not addressed in this session
